verdict.rationale: The evidence documents no bulk export of traces or datasets to blob storage (e.g. S3/GCS) or a data warehouse; OpenTelemetry export sends traces into Bento, not out of it. The CLI's ability to print raw JSON to stdout that a user could pipe into a file is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bulk-export traces and datasets to blob storage or my data warehouse
